Package io.github.jspinak.brobot.model.analysis.state.discovery

Class ImageSceneMap

java.lang.Object
io.github.jspinak.brobot.model.analysis.state.discovery.ImageSceneMap
public class ImageSceneMap extends Object
Associates a StateImage with all the scenes in which it appears.

This class maintains a mapping between an image and the set of scene identifiers where that image has been found. It's used during scene analysis to track which images appear in which scenes, facilitating scene-based image matching strategies.

  • Method Details

    • addScene

      public void addScene(int scene)
      Adds a scene identifier to this image's scene collection.

      If the scene is already associated with this image, this method has no effect (as the underlying collection is a Set).

      Parameters:
      scene - The scene identifier to add

    • addScenes

      public void addScenes(Set<Integer> scenes)
      Adds multiple scene identifiers to this image's scene collection.

      This is a convenience method that internally calls addScene(int) for each scene in the provided set. Duplicate scenes are automatically handled by the underlying Set implementation.

      Parameters:
      scenes - The collection of scene identifiers to add. Must not be null.
